music.prompt: Calm, minimal ambient electronic background for a software product video. Soft warm synth pads, gentle plucked arpeggio, light pulse, no drums, no vocals. Unobtrusive, steady, 90 bpm.

scenes.headline: Every agent deserves its own branch.
scenes.voice: Meet Treehouse. <break time="0.7s" /> Because we think every coding agent needs its own space.

scenes.label: 01 Worktrees
scenes.headline: One chat, one worktree.
scenes.sub: Every branch gets its own folder and its own Pi agent.
scenes.voice: Each chat runs a Pi agent in its own git worktree, so agents never step on each other's changes.

scenes.label: 02 Approvals
scenes.headline: You decide what runs.
scenes.sub: Commands wait for Run, Always allow or Deny.
scenes.voice: Nothing runs without you. Commands wait until you run, always allow, or deny them.

scenes.label: 03 Sub-agents
scenes.headline: Hand off the side quests.
scenes.sub: Pi starts helpers you can open, steer and stop.
scenes.voice: Pi can hand side quests to sub-agents. Open one to follow along, steer it, or stop it.

scenes.label: 04 Diff
scenes.headline: Review before you merge.
scenes.sub: Each worktree's changes, unified or side by side.
scenes.voice: When the work is done, review each worktree's changes, unified or side by side.

scenes.label: 05 Trust
scenes.headline: New projects start read-only.
scenes.sub: Trust a folder once. Pi in your terminal sees it too.
scenes.voice: New projects start read-only, until you choose to trust them.

scenes.headline: Treehouse
scenes.sub: Run Pi coding agents in git worktrees.
scenes.voice: Treehouse. Open source, and built in Rust.
